answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 9035 Country: India Title: Why people do quran khwani after someone dead. where is the proof of that at the time of prophet or sahabaas or tabe-een and tabe tabe-een or any qurani ayat or propherts hadeeth. Question: Why people do quran khwani after someone dead. where is the proof of that at the time of prophet or sahabaas or tabe-een and tabe tabe-een or any qurani ayat or propherts hadeeth. Answer ID: 9035 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1148/1148/=M/1429) The prevalent collective Quran Khwani is a custom and due to many evils it is makrooh as it is mentioned in Fatawa Hindiyah: ویکرہ للقوم أن یقرؤا القرآن جملۃ الخ Collective recitation of the Quran is not proved from the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ), his companions and those who followed them. If people want to deliver the reward to dead ( Isaal-e-thawabI ) by reciting the Quran then they should do it individually as per their convenience without fixing a date and time, and deliver the reward to the souls of the dead. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
